name: Tank Capacity Invariant
description: Reconstructs tank volume after every dispatched event and verifies that the completed safety b-thread prevents overflow.
testCode:
import main

trace = main.build_program(enable_safety=True).run(max_steps=50)
assert main.DRAIN_VALVE in trace, 'The safety b-thread must request at least one DRAIN_VALVE event'
assert trace.count(main.HOT_WATER) == main.FILL_CYCLES, 'Safety must not suppress required HOT_WATER events permanently'
assert trace.count(main.COLD_WATER) == main.FILL_CYCLES, 'Safety must not suppress required COLD_WATER events permanently'
volume = 0
for step, event in enumerate(trace, start=1):
    if event in (main.HOT_WATER, main.COLD_WATER):
        volume += 1
    elif event == main.DRAIN_VALVE:
        volume = max(0, volume - main.DRAIN_AMOUNT)
    assert volume <= main.MAX_CAPACITY, f'Safety violation at step {step}: volume={volume}, limit={main.MAX_CAPACITY}'
